stem.en: Iron rusts: 4 Fe + 3 O2 gives 2 Fe2O3. Kabir leaves a 56 g nail, one mole of iron, in a sealed jar with 16 g of oxygen, half a mole of O2. Which runs out first, and how much rust forms?

text.en: Oxygen runs out. Half a mole of O2 rusts two-thirds of a mole of iron and makes a third of a mole of rust. Some iron is left shiny.

feedback.en: One mole of iron needs three-quarters of a mole of O2. There is only half a mole. The oxygen limits.
The recipe is 4 iron to 3 oxygen, which is 1 to 0.75. Half is less than 0.75, so oxygen falls short.

text.en: Nothing rusts because the jar is sealed.

feedback.en: Rust needs oxygen, and there is oxygen in the jar. It rusts until the oxygen is used, then stops.

explanation.en: Turn each stock into "how many batches can this make". The smallest number wins, and everything else is leftover.
